decisions.decision: Hardware correlation (ORNL Prius issues 69 and 82, Honda Accord) moves to after 0.5.0. It is not a qualification.
Showing nonlinear convergence in Results, PDF and CSV (issue 12) moves to 0.5.1. The convergence fix (issue 11) stays in 0.5.0.
Magneto2D moves from 0.3.3 to 0.4.0, before the freeze, so the freeze measures the build that ships.

The owner accepts the reviewed protocol 1.6.0 references for the registered gates, with the limitations their review records: legacy current-density and new series-circuit sources in their declared roles, and V-shape kept experimental.
V-shape IPM ships experimental although all six fixtures pass: its mean fundamental back-EMF error rose from 2.39% to 6.50%.

Loaded lambda_d and lambda_q are qualified only for a qualified single-layer concentrated SPM or flat-buried IPM design under sinusoidal current at current angles from 0 to 60 degrees. Magnet derating is qualified only for a qualified design from 20 to 100 deg C. Both state that the benchmark measured up to twice its fixtures' current.

Apparent Ld and Lq, and the saliency and characteristic current from them, stay experimental even where lambda_d and lambda_q are qualified. The gate bounds each flux linkage within 3% of |lambda_dq|; at spm_8p12s_concentrated__dq_I20_g30 that band is 0.52 mWb against a 1.35 mWb change in lambda_d and a 2.46 mWb lambda_q.
The separate loss and efficiency benchmark moves to 0.5.1. Iron loss and efficiency ship experimental in 0.5.0.
